layers.label: Predicted Fire Risk
layers.description: Model-estimated probability of fire occurrence on the following day for each grid cell.
layers.interpretation: Higher values indicate cells ranked as higher risk for next-day fire occurrence.

layers.label: Maximum Temperature
layers.description: Daily maximum air temperature aggregated to each grid cell.
layers.interpretation: Higher values may indicate hotter and drier fire-weather conditions.

layers.label: Minimum Relative Humidity
layers.description: Daily minimum relative humidity aggregated to each grid cell.
layers.interpretation: Lower values may indicate drier fire-weather conditions.

layers.label: Maximum Wind Speed
layers.description: Daily maximum wind speed aggregated to each grid cell.
layers.interpretation: Higher values may indicate windier conditions that can promote fire spread.

layers.label: Slope
layers.description: Mean terrain slope within the grid cell.
layers.interpretation: Slope may influence accessibility, vegetation structure, and fire behaviour.

layers.label: Elevation
layers.description: Mean elevation of the terrain within the grid cell.
layers.interpretation: Elevation may influence climate, vegetation, and fire behaviour.

layers.label: Urban Fraction
layers.description: Fraction of the grid cell classified as urban/built-up area.
layers.interpretation: Higher values indicate more urbanized areas, which may have different fire risk profiles and fire behaviour compared to natural vegetation.

layers.label: Agriculture Fraction
layers.description: Fraction of the grid cell classified as agricultural land.
layers.interpretation: Higher values indicate more agricultural areas, which may have different fire risk profiles and fire behaviour compared to natural vegetation.

layers.label: Grass Fraction
layers.description: Fraction of the grid cell classified as grassland.
layers.interpretation: Higher values indicate more grassland areas, which may have different fire risk profiles and fire behaviour compared to other vegetation types.

layers.label: Shrub Fraction
layers.description: Fraction of the grid cell classified as shrubland.
layers.interpretation: Higher values indicate more shrubland areas, which may have different fire risk profiles and fire behaviour compared to other vegetation types.

layers.label: Forest Fraction
layers.description: Fraction of the grid cell classified as forest.
layers.interpretation: Higher values indicate more forested areas, which may have different fire risk profiles and fire behaviour compared to other vegetation types.

layers.label: Non-burnable Fraction
layers.description: Fraction of the grid cell classified as non-burnable land cover (e.g., water bodies, bare soil).
layers.interpretation: Higher values indicate more non-burnable areas, which may have lower fire risk and can act as natural firebreaks.
